root.description: Absolute path of the kept working tree.

bytes.description: Disk use of the kept envelope (tree + scoped home); null when not measured.

anyOf.description: Typed reason the previous process stopped: a vendor limit (next account eligible), the whole pool spent, a pinned account's limit, a transport death (crash, timeout, watchdog), a confirmed native tool permission refusal, context exhaustion, the run's max-turns cap, the wall-clock deadline, a cancel, a daemon/host restart, a model that asked for input, or another typed cause.

cause.description: Why the run stopped, when recorded.

ControlRetainedEnvelope.description: An isolated envelope kept for continuation: continue it with continueFrom, or release it with the discard decision.
